title: Last-coordinate fiber norm
statement: For a real number $q$ and a function $f:\{-1,1\}^{n+1}\to\mathbb R$, define a function on $\{-1,1\}^n$ by assigning to each $x$ the uniform $L^q$ norm of the two-value function $a\mapsto f(x,a)$ on $a\in\{-1,1\}$.
